description: This file contains SSL utility functions for OpenSSL error handling, version detection, and certificate chain setup within the net namespace, used in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: SslSetClearMask
classes.description: A class for managing SSL set and clear flags.

classes.name: OpenSSLNetErrorLibSingleton
classes.description: Singleton class for managing OpenSSL error library registration.

methods.name: SslSetClearMask::ConfigureFlag
methods.description: Configures a specific SSL flag to be set or cleared.

methods.name: OpenSSLNetErrorLibSingleton::OpenSSLNetErrorLibSingleton
methods.description: Constructor that initializes OpenSSL and allocates a new error library.

methods.name: OpenSSLPutNetError
methods.description: Records a network error into OpenSSL's error queue.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLError
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL error codes to net error codes.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorWithDetails
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL errors to net error codes with detailed info.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLError
methods.description: Logs OpenSSL errors to the network log.

methods.name: GetNetSSLVersion
methods.description: Returns the SSL version used in an SSL connection.

methods.name: SetSSLChainAndKey
methods.description: Sets the certificate chain and private key for an SSL connection.
